title.zh: Meta联手傅利叶3个月造出人形机器人原型，想给Muse装上手和脚
title.en: Meta联手傅利叶3个月造出人形机器人原型，想给Muse装上手和脚

current_state.zh: Meta partnered with Shanghai-based Fourier Intelligence to build a humanoid robot prototype called Max in three months, using Fourier's hardware and Meta's design and AI software as a step toward giving its Muse AI agent a physical body for household tasks.
current_state.en: Meta partnered with Shanghai-based Fourier Intelligence to build a humanoid robot prototype called Max in three months, using Fourier's hardware and Meta's design and AI software as a step toward giving its Muse AI agent a physical body for household tasks.
